coverage_notes.Anthropic: Official https://www.anthropic.com/news newsroom listing; RSS was not validated. Collector extracts only same-host news links with a date from the associated official card, then falls back to Article JSON-LD.
coverage_notes.Rockstar Games: Official https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire?tag_id=43 Newswire listing; no unofficial source is used. Collector reads dated first-party listing cards and then JSON-LD. Technical-interest-only remains mandatory.
coverage_notes.IBM: Official https://newsroom.ibm.com/announcements?format=rss&l=50 RSS is attempted first; malformed XML in the 2026-09-26 run led to an official HTML listing fallback at https://newsroom.ibm.com/announcements.
coverage_notes.Oracle: Official https://blogs.oracle.com/rss is attempted first; HTTP 403 in the 2026-09-26 run led to the official Oracle Blogs HTML listing fallback at https://blogs.oracle.com/.
coverage_notes.Adobe: Official Adobe Newsroom listing https://news.adobe.com/news; the collector uses same-host dated cards and Article JSON-LD as fallbacks. RSS was not validated.
coverage_notes.Qualcomm: Official press releases https://www.qualcomm.com/news/releases; the collector discovers first-party RSS/Atom if advertised, otherwise uses dated same-host listing cards and Article JSON-LD.
coverage_notes.xAI: Official https://x.ai/news listing; RSS was not validated. The collector uses dated first-party cards and Article JSON-LD when available.
coverage_notes.Tesla: Official Tesla Blog https://www.tesla.com/blog is attempted first; https://www.tesla.com/en_gb/blog is the first-party HTML fallback after HTTP 403. Technology/software relevance remains mandatory.
coverage_notes.Google: Coverage is split across Google AI, DeepMind, general Developers, and Android Developers feeds.
coverage_notes.Google Cloud: Official https://cloud.google.com/blog listing; the collector tries publisher feed discovery, dated same-host HTML cards, then Article JSON-LD. Any newly discovered feed is host-allowlisted.
coverage_notes.Microsoft: Microsoft Source and Azure engineering blog are separate; GitHub is independently monitored.
coverage_notes.Amazon: Corporate/product news is distinct from AWS What's New.
coverage_notes.Meta: Meta Newsroom and Meta Engineering are complemented by the official AI at Meta listing https://ai.meta.com/blog/; dated same-host cards are supported without requiring Article JSON-LD.

topics: relevant technical developments from Rockstar Games
